Trailer forms of both kinds, and the equipment sections of the H2S daily, are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph — a damaged gauge, a torn mask bag, a cracked hose — would not surface in this review, because what reaches me is the text of the form and the capture timestamp of each image, not the image itself. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside those images and are never recorded as text, so this review cannot tell you whether any of them are current. Separately, this run executed at about 10:15 PM Central, before the 11/10 Central day closed, so any submission filed late tonight or arriving tomorrow morning is not included.
